scope: Read saved validation predictions only; no fitting, tuning, test reads, or raw RX preprocessing
primary_endpoint: post-NLTCP full PAM4 pair correctness; invalid decisions always wrong; also predecoder complex PAM6 symbol correctness
strata_policy: Validation quantiles are descriptive only, never used to train/select a gate or threshold. All bins reported. Ideal regions are label-based explanations, not deployment inputs.
oracle: Pointwise choice between already independently decoded branch outputs is truth-assisted diagnostic only. No switching/redecoding or reported deployed oracle BER; NLTCP previous-state dependence prevents equating it to predecoder switching.
decision: Assess nonzero mutual rescue, prevalence relative to errors and persistence across blocks/channels. Such potential alone does not justify a new architecture. Recommend new training only if observable descriptive patterns give a specific credible hypothesis; do not select models or gates from these reused validation data.
limitations: one seed for each branch per matched pair
same current 115-symbol window and leak; cannot directly measure a new long-memory/short-nonlinearity architecture
